cohort: 81 pregnant women with ITP and a platelet count < 30 × 10(9)/L who did not respond to steroids and/or intravenous immunoglobulin
finding: rhTPO may be an effective and safe treatment option for pregnancies with ITP that do not respond to first-line treatment, and it may have slightly prolonged the gestational age of delivery.
gest_age: Delivery gestational age reported (longer in the rhTPO group)
